description: Read a power cable datasheet (a maker PDF, an https link to one, or pasted datasheet or tender text) into constructions: every cable size it states with voltage, cores, conductor, each layer with its nominal and smallest thickness, screen and armour data, diameters and the claimed standards, each with the page and the row it was read from, the values that could not be read and the ones the reader is unsure of. The reading is done by an LLM (Claude) and shown as read; it decides nothing. Each construction is ready for check_cable / POST /api/v1/check, and with standard set every row is checked by the deterministic rule engine in the same call, each rule with its clause and source. Review the values before relying on a verdict.

hint.description: A designation or size to look for, e.g. "3x95/25 12/20 kV": only matching rows are returned.

standard.description: Also check every row: "auto" (the standards each row claims, else IEC 60502 by voltage) or rule sets, comma separated.

text.description: Pasted datasheet, catalogue or tender text.

url.description: An https link to a PDF datasheet or a datasheet web page.

name: extract_datasheet
title: Read a cable datasheet into constructions
